tests.name: the Kiro run routes the reattach finishes runs for are still mounted and admin-only
tests.reason: read-only GET without a token; the deployed build still serves the run API a reattached run is read through

the real run service, executor, Kiro turn runner and ACP client over the fake database: a deploy mid-run lets the session go and the new task reattaches it (contiguous seq, one reply, no interrupted event), an open card is shown again and answered, a refused reattach is interrupted exactly as in Phase 1, a crashed task's run is reattached inside the window and interrupted past it; every Phase 1 run scenario unchanged

token derived from the run's nonce and never stored, the candidate rule, ACP adoption and detach, the real remote backend over a real socket (header-only token, close 1001, reattached frame and same-tick replay, 4403/4404 refusals), wiring and migration

a socket drop mid-turn keeps kiro-cli alive and buffers its output; the buffer cap ends the session; wrong, missing or expired token and wrong user or thread are refused; a reattach replays the buffered frames and unanswered requests in order; idle and lifetime timers still end a detached session
